cells.gaps: The government's statement that SIGE is 'already used in all' basic and secondary schools (June 2025) gives no count and no rural share; no figure separates rural schools, and nothing shows attendance entered daily in practice rather than required. Nothing is dated inside the last twelve months; the donor finance stated is for one module only.
cells.note: Bill's ruling (messages-for-bill 141): the government's statement that SIGE is used in all schools counts as a published share, so with marks and absences entered per pupil during the year the cell meets stage 4. Stage 5 needs a share for rural schools, and none is published.
